parameters.query:
insert into tec_snapshots
  (pull_date, project_id, developer, plant_type, mw, connection_date, status, raw)
values
  ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)
on conflict (pull_date, project_id) do nothing;

with pulls as (
  select distinct pull_date from tec_snapshots order by pull_date desc limit 2
),
latest as (
  select * from tec_snapshots where pull_date = (select max(pull_date) from pulls)
),
previous as (
  select * from tec_snapshots
  where pull_date = (
    select min(pull_date) from pulls where pull_date < (select max(pull_date) from pulls)
  )
)
select l.pull_date, l.project_id, l.developer, l.plant_type, l.mw,
       l.connection_date, l.status
from latest l
left join previous p on p.project_id = l.project_id
where p.project_id is null
order by l.mw desc nulls last;

insert into fired_signals
  (developer, tier, confirmation_score, confirmation_sources, tec_project_id, slack_message_ts)
values
  ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
returning signal_id;

parameters.content:
## Stage 1 — Source
NESO TEC register (UK transmission queue).
Datapackage JSON resolves the CSV URL dynamically — the path changes between releases.

## Stage 2 — Snapshot + Diff
Upsert every row of this pull into `tec_snapshots`,
then return rows present in latest pull but not in the previous one.
First-run safe: if no previous pull exists, all rows are returned.

## Stage 3 — Filter
Keep BESS only (`/battery|storage|bess/i`)
AND connection date inside 2027-01-01 → 2035-12-31.
Then cap at 10 developers/run by MW desc to keep Clay credits ≤ $1.

## Stage 4 — Enrich (Clay)
POST each developer to a Clay table.
Clay enriches: domain, LinkedIn, news, hiring signals,
count of other TEC entries by same dev.
Clay POSTs back to the Wait webhook.

## Stage 5 — Confirm
Parallel: TED tenders (CPV 09310000 / 31682500) + Google News RSS.
Code node scores keyword bag — NO LLM.
+1 per keyword, +2 per TED hit, +1 per news hit.

## Stage 6 — Route
- Tier 1: score ≥ 4  OR  (multiple TEC entries AND any news hit)
- Tier 2: score ≥ 1
- Drop: score = 0  (phantom-project guard)

## Stage 7 — Slack
Incoming webhook, Block Kit:
bold developer header, MW prominent, tier + score,
up to 3 source link buttons (TED / news).

## Stage 8 — Log
Write to `fired_signals` for the audit trail.
Runs after Slack so we capture the message ts when available.
